status: Command catalog of the accrete Kernel this package carries, the version in accrete.cli of its package.json. Every entry and long flag is checked against that binary's --help by scripts/check-cli-contract.mjs.

input.from: UTF-8 JSON, or Markdown for memory append
input.stdin: --from - for object creation, amendments, Data locations and Memory; import and migrate need real paths
input.amendment: JSON Merge Patch of editable fields
input.selector: Object arguments accept a stable ID, a name or an alias; IDs take priority and an ambiguous alias is a conflict
input.id: 1-180 ASCII letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens, and not . or ..; generated as a UUID when not supplied

commands.usage: accrete migrate --from LEGACY [--dry-run]
commands.effect: Convert the old scaffold's metadata, retaining original backups and an identity map.

commands.usage: accrete migrate [--dry-run]
commands.effect: Handle persisted format changes, keeping identities and relationships. With only format 1 in existence it reports the project is current and changes nothing.

commands.usage: accrete config resolve --json
commands.effect: Report resolved project roots, host, metadata view, state directory and index path without disclosing credentials or writing objects.

commands.usage: accrete interface --json
commands.effect: Report CLI, interface and format versions and exit codes; needs no Workspace.

commands.usage: accrete model register [--from FILE] [--checkout PATH] [--id ID] [--name NAME] [--description TEXT] [--source-scope PATH]
commands.effect: Allocate a Model identity for an existing Git checkout or a repository locator supplied in JSON. Does not clone or fetch. A checkout becomes a host-local binding.

commands.usage: accrete model bind MODEL_ID --checkout PATH
commands.effect: Set this host's checkout binding for a known Model.

commands.usage: accrete model update MODEL_ID --from FILE --expect REVISION
commands.effect: Amend the Model descriptor; source history stays in Git.

commands.usage: accrete model retire MODEL_ID --expect REVISION [--from FILE]
commands.effect: End current use while preserving identity, repository and earlier associations. The optional JSON may carry reason.

commands.usage: accrete model iteration open MODEL_ID [--from FILE] [--id ID] [--name NAME] [--purpose TEXT] [--branch BRANCH] [--worktree PATH] [--start REVISION] [--existing]
commands.effect: Describe an iteration. --worktree creates a worktree of the Model's repository unless --existing attaches one; without --worktree no storage is allocated. Flags override --from fields of the same name.

commands.usage: accrete model iteration close ITERATION_ID --expect REVISION [--from FILE] [--outcome TEXT] [--commit COMMIT]
commands.effect: Retain the outcome, summary and every selected commit. Outcome is required from the file or --outcome; --commit repeats. Merging and worktree removal stay separate.

commands.usage: accrete model iteration remove-worktree ITERATION_ID [--force]
commands.effect: Remove the iteration's bound worktree through Git, keeping Git's refusal for changed work unless --force is given.

commands.usage: accrete tool admit [--from FILE] [--id ID] [--name NAME] [--description TEXT] [--source PATH] [--source-mode live|retained] [--revision COMMIT]
commands.effect: Give an existing capability a Tool identity and explicit live or retained source selection.

commands.usage: accrete tool bind TOOL_ID --source PATH
commands.effect: Set this host's source binding for a known Tool.

commands.usage: accrete tool update TOOL_ID --from FILE --expect REVISION
commands.effect: Amend metadata or source selection without changing the user's active implementation checkout.

commands.usage: accrete tool expose TOOL_ID --agent codex|claude [--mode wrapper|symlink] [--name NAME] [--destination DIRECTORY]
commands.effect: Create a project-local discovery binding to actual source material; default to a portable source-reading wrapper.

commands.usage: accrete tool refresh TOOL_ID [--agent codex|claude]
commands.effect: Refresh existing managed exposures, reporting unavailable or pending source material; a retired Tool's local exposures are removed where possible.

commands.usage: accrete tool retire TOOL_ID --expect REVISION [--from FILE]
commands.effect: Retain identity and associations while ending normal discovery; preserve source material and running work. The optional JSON may carry reason.

commands.usage: accrete tool export TOOL_ID --to PATH
commands.effect: Create a new local directory with tool.json and source/; external publication remains a separate action.

commands.usage: accrete data register --from FILE [--id ID] [--name NAME] [--description TEXT] [--result RESULT_ID] [--live]
commands.effect: Describe Data and usable locations without mandatory payload copying, packing or hashing.

commands.usage: accrete data register --path PATH [--id ID] [--name NAME] [--description TEXT] [--kind file|directory|collection|external] [--hash] [--result RESULT_ID] [--live]
commands.effect: Register a local borrowed path in place. --hash computes SHA-256 for one regular file.

commands.usage: accrete data amend DATA_ID --from FILE --expect REVISION
commands.effect: Change descriptive metadata. Closed content and the locations array cannot change this way.

commands.usage: accrete data location add DATA_ID [--from FILE] [--location NAME] [--path PATH] [--kind filesystem|rclone|external] [--expect REVISION]
commands.effect: Add a borrowed locator for the same described content; do not redefine earlier Result inputs. A repeated matching location is a no-op.

commands.usage: accrete data materialize DATA_ID [--to LOCATION] [--source SOURCE_LOCATION] [--expect REVISION]
commands.effect: Produce and publish a managed replica at a configured filesystem location (default working) using local transfer or the configured rclone adapter.

commands.usage: accrete data evict DATA_ID --location LOCATION [--expect REVISION]
commands.effect: Remove precisely one Kernel-managed replica named by location ID or name, preserving the Data identity and other locations. An ambiguous name is a conflict.

commands.usage: accrete data retire DATA_ID --expect REVISION [--from FILE]
commands.effect: End current use while preserving identity, locations and earlier associations; no bytes are removed. The optional JSON may carry reason.

commands.usage: accrete result record [--from FILE] [--id ID] [--name NAME] [--description TEXT] [--observe-checkout PATH]
commands.effect: Persist a useful activity description and its supplied Model, Tool and Data associations. --observe-checkout adds a separately labelled recording-time observation.

commands.usage: accrete result amend RESULT_ID --from FILE --expect REVISION
commands.effect: Apply an explicit correction or enrichment against the actual current document bytes.

commands.usage: accrete result observe RESULT_ID --text-file FILE [--operation-id ID]
commands.effect: Append an independent observation to the observations array; an operation ID makes retries unambiguous.

commands.usage: accrete result capture --checkout PATH --path SOURCE_PATH --to DIRECTORY
commands.effect: Write a selected binary Git diff and selected nonignored untracked files to a new directory with a manifest of the captured scope. --path repeats. It is not a complete executable environment.

commands.usage: accrete memory append --from FILE [--id ID] [--title TITLE] [--authored-at RFC3339] [--result ID] [--model ID] [--tool ID] [--data ID] [--supersedes ID] [--links-from FILE]
commands.effect: Publish complete authored Markdown with a stable ID, timezone-based path and repeatable object links. Retry a lost acknowledgement with the same --id.

commands.usage: accrete index refresh
commands.effect: Refresh the host-local disposable SQLite projection from the selected metadata view.

commands.usage: accrete export --to PATH [--id ID]
commands.effect: Write a metadata bundle of selected or all managed documents. Payloads, Git objects, Tool source and machine bindings stay out. --id repeats.

commands.usage: accrete import --from PATH [--allow-foreign]
commands.effect: Import a metadata bundle object by object, reporting each outcome. A batch is not atomic; repeating it completes missing entries.

commands.usage: accrete recover [--operation OPERATION_ID]
commands.effect: Reconcile interrupted transfers, evictions, worktree creation and uncertain publications from their receipts. Never relaunches scientific computation. --operation limits Data reconciliation to one operation.

receipt.multi_effects: enumerate actual written paths and any pending projections/exposures
receipt.index_pending: primary publication succeeded; exit 0; repair with index refresh
receipt.published_uncertain: published=true, durability=uncertain, object ID/path and recovery details; exit 8; continue with recover
receipt.error: stable category plus committed/published state and surviving paths

exit_codes.0: success, including a committed document whose index refresh is pending
exit_codes.2: invalid invocation, input or unsupported format
exit_codes.3: unresolved configuration or project, or absent object
exit_codes.4: revision, identity, ownership or destination conflict
exit_codes.6: storage failure before the requested publication completes
exit_codes.7: incomplete external operation or partially failed import
exit_codes.8: publication is visible but durability is uncertain
